signin.title: Sign in
signin.text: Sign in with your web login name and password. No password yet, or forgot it? Send /web to Argus on another channel (Telegram): it answers with a link that signs you in once, within ten minutes, and lets you set one.
signin.limited: Too many failed attempts. Wait a quarter of an hour, or use a /web link.
governor.title: Governor
constellation.title: Agent constellation
constellation.aria: Projects around the front desk, with their state and the share of today's budget used
constellation.none: No projects yet. Create one with /new in the chat.
spend.title: Spend
approvals.title: Awaiting approval
approvals.approveAll: All of this kind, this run
approvals.gone: That question was answered or expired already.
checkpoint.title: checkpoint
checkpoint.text: Reached its checkpoint after {steps} steps. Go on?
runs.title: Live runs
schedule.title: Next 24 hours
schedule.none: Nothing scheduled. /cron in the chat adds a schedule.
log.title: Signal log
chat.title: Chat
chat.hint: The same as the Telegram chat: plain text goes to the active project or the front desk, /commands run.
settings.title: Settings
settings.keysHint: A key is checked with the provider before it is saved, and used from the next request.
settings.toolsHint: off: not offered to the agent · deny · ask: you are asked · allow: runs unasked
settings.instructionsHint: What each project is told to do, in its system prompt on every request. Saving applies from its next request; an empty text removes them.
password.title: Web password
password.none: You have no web password yet. Choose a login name and a password of at least 10 characters to sign in without a /web link.
password.has: Your login name is {login}. Changing the password signs out your other sessions.
password.reset: You signed in with a /web link: for ten minutes you can set a new password without the current one.
password.saved: Saved. Your other sessions are signed out.
password.short: The password needs at least 10 characters.
password.badLogin: A login name is 2 to 64 letters, digits or . _ @ -
users.title: Users
users.inviteHint: Creates an operator and gives a sign-in link valid 24 hours, to send them. With it they set a web password; from the web they can connect Telegram.
users.name: Name
channels.title: Your channels
channels.hint: To use Argus from Telegram too, ask for a code and send it to the bot as /link <code> within 10 minutes.
projects.title: Projects
projects.newHint: Creates the folder and the project file, ready at once. The id is lowercase letters, digits and dashes; without a model it uses the tasks model.
projects.missing: There is no project {id} (or it is archived).
tasks.title: Recent tasks
tasks.hint: Runs once, outside any project, on the tasks model and the tasks budget. Estimate shows what a typical and a big task have cost, and how many the budget left allows.
schedule.addHint: Five cron fields in the configured timezone: minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week. A project gets the text as a message; a task runs it once each time.
costs.title: Spending and budgets
system.title: System
system.panicHint: Panic stops every run, rejects what is queued and refuses new work until you resume.
system.panicked: Everything is stopped (panic). Resume to accept work again.
setup.adminText: There is no admin yet. Create the admin's account: the login name and password you will sign in with. The link works once.
setup.invalid: This setup link is no longer valid. Run argus setup-link on the server for a new one.
setup.title: Set up Argus
setup.intro: What a new install needs, step by step. Every step runs a chat command, and each can be changed later in Settings.
setup.adminDone: You are the admin, signing in as {login}.
setup.keyHint: No agent can run without one. The key is checked with the provider before it is saved.
setup.modelsHint: The model a task runs on, and the front desk's. The defaults are fine to start with.
setup.telegramHint: To use Argus from Telegram as well: save the bot token from @BotFather (the bot starts at once), then connect your Telegram account with a code.
setup.projectHint: A project is an agent with its own folder, memory, model and budget. A template gives it instructions to start from; edit them on the project's page.
setup.systemText: Timezone {timezone}; every project may spend ${day} a day and ${month} a month unless set otherwise. These are in ops.yaml (timezone, budgets) and apply after a restart; /budget changes one budget at once.
setup.banner: Argus is not fully set up yet: it needs a provider key and a first project.
signin.codeText: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
signin.badCode: That code is not right, or it was used already. After five wrong codes, start again.
totp.title: Authenticator code
totp.off: Off. With it on, every sign-in also asks for a 6-digit code from an authenticator app (Aegis, Google Authenticator, 1Password…). It is required when the web is public.
totp.required: This web interface is public: set up an authenticator code before anything else.
totp.scan: Add this key to your authenticator app (on a phone, the link opens it), then enter the code it shows.
totp.badCode: That code is not right. Check the phone’s clock, and try the next code.
totp.recovery: On. Keep these recovery codes somewhere safe: each one signs you in once without the phone. They are not shown again.
totp.on: On: every sign-in asks for a code. To turn it off, enter a code.
totp.onPublic: On. It is required while the web is public.
